applicability: Any 'a% of b' with real a and b: a% of b = b% of a exactly, for every pair, because both equal a*b/100. It is a shortcut whenever one side is the friendlier number to take a percent of. It applies to 'of' only, not to 'a% off b'.
carry_case: The swap holds for 'of' but not for 'off': 20% off 50 = 40 while 50% off 20 = 10. In general a% off b = b% off a only when a = b.

steps.working: a% of b = b% of a

operand_draw.mapping: declared before the draw: draws[0] is the percent a; draws[1] = k gives the base b = 25*k, a quarter-lattice base so the flipped side lands on a number a viewer can halve and quarter on screen. The identity is exact for every real pair, so the lattice constrains presentation only, never whether the method works.
